# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform integration, rendering reliability, and allocation behavior across managed and native code. The release updates platform support for Apple, Windows, Linux, Android, and WebAssembly while reducing overhead in image processing, text shaping, and stream handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **C string data is copied safely** — SKData creation from a C string now reads the intended buffer directly, preventing reads past the native string boundary. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Texture rendering on Android is synchronized with the display refresh cycle for more reliable frame presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and text processing allocate less** — Managed image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string processing avoid unnecessary allocations in common processing paths. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Front-buffered streams no longer retain buffered content longer than necessary. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Apple platform minimums are raised** — Apple-targeted applications now require the updated minimum deployment versions supported by the 4.156 line. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Windows native dependencies align with MAUI** — Windows native assets now align with the dependency sets used by MAUI 9 and MAUI 10. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420))
- **Native WebGPU and Linux HarfBuzz integration is improved** — WebAssembly packages include the emdawnwebgpu implementation, while Linux loads bundled HarfBuzz functions locally. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
